radius.$description: Corner radius by object type, same on every platform. Bigger surfaces get bigger radius. Nested element: inner = outer − padding (never below xs) when the padding is smaller than the outer radius; otherwise the inner element keeps its own radius.

none.$description: Square corners. Anything attached to a screen edge — app bar, sidebar, navigation rail, full-bleed media, table cells.

xxs.$description: Hairline rounding for tiny marks: progress and slider tracks, inline code.

xs.$description: Inner corners of joined segments (button group, split button), checkbox, small badge, tags inside dense text.

sm.$description: Tooltip, chips and tags, rounded-square avatar sm.

md.$description: Default control radius: Button, Icon button, Text field, Select, Segmented button at sm, md and lg; small popovers; rounded-square avatar md.

lg.$description: Menus, dropdown lists and popovers anchored to a control (split button menu); rounded-square avatar lg.

xl.$description: xl (56) controls on tablet and mobile, list items shown as cards, rounded-square avatar xl.

2xl.$description: Cards, dashboard widgets, tiles, banners inside content.

4xl.$description: Bottom and side sheets (only the corners facing the content), hero containers.

full.$description: Pills and circles: circular avatar, switch track and thumb, count and dot badges, pill chips. Never on rectangles that can grow tall.
